name: Jake Chapman
description: Jake Chapman is a Managing Director at Army Venture Capital Corporation and focuses on companies working on technology that enhances the national security of the United States of America. The sectors I focus on are AI, Robotics, Aerospace, Autonomy, Quantum Computing, Semiconductors, Manufacturing, Security, Biotech, Defense, Energy and related industries.

investment_theses.quote: Every company is a good investment at the right price.
I think you're making a difference in the world. And I think you're going to make a boatload of money. When I can combine those two things, it really gets me excited.
You never really know what the relationship is going to be like before you invest. But once you invest, sometimes you figure out that this thing you thought was great is mind-blowingly great.
